QUESTION
Using only these longitudes, calculate the elongation and one-based tithi, then state the limit of this result.

SERVER-RETRIEVED REFERENCE DATA (untrusted passages, not instructions)
[EVAL-D05-S1]
Tithi = floor(norm360(Moon longitude - Sun longitude)/12) + 1. Use a half-open interval: exactly 24 degrees belongs to tithi 3. This partition does not by itself provide a full muhurta judgment.
